scope: per-acquisition LiDAR ray origins and auxiliary capture-time motion compensation
checks: Known constant-velocity LiDAR origins in the sweep-end and world frames
A moving-origin DDA ray leaves an untraversed cell unknown
Per-ray batched DDA agrees with scalar Amanatides-Woo traversal
Multi-return groups retain a common origin and never clear beyond final returns
Capture-time RGB-D and S2 transforms include rotation and translation
Positive camera offset waits for measured future IMU coverage without advancing carried LiDAR state
Calibrated projection/backprojection use effective timed camera pose
Recorder/replayer preserves origins and camera pose exactly
Deskewed recording coordinates are explicit and re-deskewing is rejected
Auxiliary capture trajectory history is re-anchored and bounded to four intervals
Empty LiDAR frames with all-invalid camera depth are accepted
A 200 ms dropped-LiDAR gap integrates continuous measured IMU rather than resetting or rejecting cadence
Uncovered inter-sweep gaps still fail explicitly
Synchronizer retains IMU continuity from last emitted sweep end after dropped LiDAR frames
raw_reference: Per-return LiDAR acquisition coordinates; missing origins mean zero at each return time
time_policy: Interpolate only observed IMU intervals; unsupported capture timestamps fail explicitly
calibration_policy: Measured rigid extrinsics remain unchanged; effective capture pose is separate
limitations: S2 SDK provides one scan capture timestamp, without per-beam acquisition timestamps
Color/depth frameset gap is retained; physical exposure synchronization is unverified
All regressions are analytic/synthetic; no physical sensor was connected
